name: oh-my-design
description: One command, ultradesign: designs a marketing page, a multi-screen product or a redesign from a one-line request, one cycle at a time. Each cycle makes the work, has a cold outside eye look at it, and stops to show you; reply "one more" or "continue".

interface.shortDescription: One design command: ultradesign makes, has a cold eye look, and stops to show you
